tools.name: match_listings
tools.description: Find catalogue listings using an explicit blood-test, panel or health-check name and an optional Irish location. Returns sourced comparison facts only; it does not assess symptoms or clinical suitability.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Return published catalogue facts for one exact listing id, including price, location and markers when published.

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: Browse or filter names of blood tests, panels and health checks in the compiled Irish catalogue. This is catalogue navigation, not a clinical recommendation.

tools.name: render_results
tools.description: Compare up to ten exact listing ids returned by match_listings using catalogue price, location and published marker facts.
